description.zh:
业务流程的ID，
您可以使用[ListBusiness](~~173945~~)获取对应业务流程的ID。
description.en: The workflow ID. You can call the [ListBusiness](~~173945~~) operation to obtain the workflow ID.

description.zh:
文件夹的ID，
您可以使用[GetFolder](~~173952~~)或者[ListFolders](~~173955~~)获取对应文件夹的ID。
description.en: The ID of the folder. You can call the [GetFolder](~~173952~~) or [ListFolders](~~173955~~) operation to obtain the folder ID.

description.zh:
DataWorks工作空间的ID，
您可以单击页面右上角的小扳手图标，进入工作空间管理页面查看。
description.en: The ID of the DataWorks workspace. You can click the wrench icon in the top-right corner to access the workspace management page and view the ID.

description.zh:
DataWorks工作空间的唯一标识符，即数据开发页面顶部切换工作空间处的英文标识。


该参数与ProjectId参数二者必须设置其一，以确定本次API调用操作的DataWorks工作空间。
description.en:
The unique identifier of the DataWorks workspace. This is the identifier shown in the workspace switcher at the top of the Data Studio page.

Either this parameter or ProjectId must be specified to determine which DataWorks workspace this API call operates on.

description.zh:
表的UUID，
您可以通过[SearchMetaTables](~~173919~~)获取对应表的UUID。
description.en: The UUID of the table. You can call the [SearchMetaTables](~~173919~~) operation to obtain the table UUID.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dataworks-public establish-relation-table-to-business --project-id 10000 --project-identifier dw --business-id 1000001 --table-guid odps.dw_project.tb1 --folder-id 2eb6f90000 --api-version 2024-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
